shapes.description: Fixed time or steps remaining before an inevitable occurrence.
Distance between hunters and prey with gains and losses.
Multiple factions competing to achieve a milestone first.
Escalating attention from law enforcement or syndicate syndicates.
Geographic or contagion infection moving outward.
Clues accumulated toward uncovering a mastermind or hidden truth.
A fleeting window of fortune closing as actions are taken.
Political hierarchy, reputation tiers, or faction standing.

complications: A supply line is severed by roving marauders.
An unexpected weather anomaly delays travel by 1 day.
A rival adventuring company arrives seeking the same bounty.
A trusted merchant reveals they have been blackmailed by local syndicates.
A planar tremor destabilizes arcane wards across the region.
A dormant disease spreads from harvested monster carcases.
A local faction leader is replaced by a shadowy impostor.
A hidden dungeon collapse exposes an unmapped deeper level.
